## OWNER #381-B2 — ISOLATED EFFECTIVE-VISIBILITY ORACLE: TEST-ONLY EXECUTION GO (2026-10-13)

**Phase:** ACTIVE_DEVELOPMENT, Zen Canvas has never been publicly released and has no release schedule. This is a **bounded Codex Cloud test-only research authorization, NOT production or merge GO**. Current master pinned at authorization: `3275ac7c72df8ae4139a30f16c7f649971324e97` / Tree `009576241cd4e8e2ba12cc644a368314f599faa6`; reread immediately before execution. Existing [#383](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/pull/383) remains **OPEN/Draft, DESIGN BLOCKED** (Hosted Windows 100k ~5284ms writer lock > 5000ms competing writer budget). Provisional Schema v38 **UNALLOCATED**. [#394](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/pull/394) B1 static inventory remains OPEN/Draft with **exact-head docs CI SUCCESS**, not a product merge.

**Research conclusion inherited from source-grounded B1:** frozen 103 stale/121 writer/54 direct-files-read group IDs are internal static labels; **six STG-114..119 functions under `#[cfg(test)]` + ten WFG-195..204 in Windows test module are NOT product entry points**. Actual Tauri registered 209 commands, incl. 40 D-16-only independent interfaces (8 service / 22 user-selected File Workspace / 10 Storage Analyzer). The remaining 169 registrations are not proven handler callgraphs. B2 MUST NOT claim production authority coverage based on these counts. Frozen D4-S8/S8R artifacts remain unchanged.

### Execution boundaries (one isolated Codex Cloud Draft PR)
- Proposed branch: `test/issue-381-b2-effective-visibility-oracle`
- Proposed title: `test(managed-scan): #381-B2 isolated effective-visibility oracle`
- **Allowed NEW files ONLY:** `tests/issue381_b2/**` and `docs/project/research/issue-381-b2/**`.
- No product `src-tauri/src/**`, `src/**`, existing test edits, `Cargo.toml`/lock changes, `package.json`, Schema, IPC/Service, `scanner.rs`, `watcher.rs`, Global Index scope/defaults, CI workflow changes or release. No new workflow file (its routing can trigger out-of-scope full-performance CI). Do not run Codex Review, manually dispatch Full Validation, merge, close Issue or edit master.
- Use a **fresh temporary SQLite** fixture and a **separate small-set oracle** (independent implementation, not the same SQL twice). Python stdlib sqlite3/unit tests or isolated test-only Rust harness without repo manifest edits are appropriate; record exact Python/SQLite version/source ID and whether FTS5 exists. This is a **research model**, not product SQLite 3.51.3 qualification, actual OS physical identity, or native 100k claim.

### Required model semantics
1. File **source incarnation UID** independent of path, with independent physical OS identity observation, file-observation revision and **retained** tag/notes/classification/history; same-path replacement MUST NOT inherit earlier source annotations.
2. Root identity, enabled status, published_epoch, run/session/root/Watcher revisions, source-writer watermark and complete source membership **per root per epoch**. Overlapping/nested roots must not let one root erase another root's valid file claim. Query scope must explicitly restrict allowed roots.
3. Stage complete *immutable candidate/member sets* in bounded transactions while E0 stays authoritative; failure/cancel/gap/UNCERTAIN leaves E0 and truthful `reconciliation_required`.
4. Publication `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` may do only **constant-size** root/run/session/Watcher/writer CAS + epoch pointer/revision/derived-authority invalidation, then commit. **No** 100k row UPDATE, FTS rebuild, full-candidate or OS filesystem walk while holding publication writer lock. Wrong ownership/ABA => rollback, not restore via unconditional row update.
5. Cleanup and derived revalidation must be restartable, bounded, user-data preserving. Stale AI/Dedupe/Content/Analysis completions/history cannot become current actionable truth without source/epoch/CAS; path equality alone is never authority.
6. List/count/selection/detail/preview/FTS and cursor must agree on the same effective visibility revision; execution-time path/physical identity and permissions must be revalidated separately. Query tokens are rejected if source/scope/rank authority changes.
7. **Important S8 already-frozen FTS decision:** reference ranking is **BM25 over precisely the effective-visible managed document corpus**, not all physically retained `files_fts` rows. Post-filter-after-LIMIT is a failure; computing BM25 against hidden physical rows then filtering does not prove the accepted corpus semantics. A small isolated visible-only reference FTS is valid oracle evidence, NOT a justified production-cost approach. Product SQLite 3.51.3/FTS query plans/100k+ scale are later gates.
8. No older publicly released app exists. Historic K1/K2/G1 old-binary generation isolation is NOT a current development prerequisite; same-version concurrent DB/source protections ARE still mandatory.

### Required positive cases B2-T01..T16
T01 empty and 1-file visibility; T02 E1 staged batches not externally visible until commit; T03 atomic CAS pointer and same-transaction list/count; T04 overlapping/nested roots; T05 explicitly selected root named `build` versus unrelated basename; T06 same-path newer physical file incarnation ABA; T07 concurrent Watcher/upsert/root revision; T08 incomplete/cancelled/gap/UNKNOWN health; T09 durable user tags/notes/feedback CAS and no path-based inheritance; T10 stale async job completion/AI/analysis/duplicate results; T11 execution-time source/physical identity; T12 FTS filter **before LIMIT**; T13 BM25 hidden-doc corpus adversary vs visible-only reference; T14 global/root-scope cursor and true rank invalidation; T15 subprocess crash during P1/P2/P3-before-COMMIT/P3-after-COMMIT/P4, old-or-new only; T16 0/10k/100k isolated writer contention and raw SQLite latency, with existing 5000ms competing-writer threshold unchanged and truthful non-native provenance. Use deterministic barriers, explicit pass/fail assertions and replay fixtures.

### Required expected-rejected counterexamples B2-N01..N06
N01 naive multi-commit `is_stale` must expose mixed generation; N02 stale cursor silently accepted; N03 same-path source/tag inheritance; N04 root-A global tombstone hides root-B; N05 FTS global BM25/post-LIMIT hidden leakage/underfill; N06 stale worker/Watcher revision ignored. Produce JSON `expected_rejection_observed`, not generic PASS for a deliberately broken implementation. If any negative is missed => **CONTRACT BLOCKED**.

### Evidence, qualification and stop
- Each T/N case: exact fixture seed, expected and actual source IDs/order/count/revision, event schedule, independent oracle diff and unmodified raw JSON results.
- Exact source SHA256, Python/SQLite version/source ID, compile opts, OS, real execution commands/exit codes, branch base/HEAD/Tree, all file diffs, SQLite WAL/page data and writer latency raw records; do not fabricate percentile/OS/migration claims.
- Normal PR CI may classify as docs/tests and **not run standalone harness**. Independently run harness in Codex environment and report it as such, not exact-head Hosted Windows/macOS qualification. If FTS5 unavailable, mark affected semantic gates **ENVIRONMENT_UNAVAILABLE** and stop, do not substitute LIKE.
- Stop OPEN/Draft for Owner review at `B2_TEST_ONLY_ORACLE_READY_FOR_OWNER_REVIEW` only if T01..16 pass and N01..06 are correctly rejected, with provenance qualification. Else `B2_CONTRACT_BLOCKED` or `B2_ENVIRONMENT_UNAVAILABLE`.
- PR #383 remains DESIGN BLOCKED and no production owner code, v38, publish/release or retroactive B1 merge is authorized. Final B2 is only evidence for separate B3 architecture decision.

**Authorized:** `#381_B2_TEST_ONLY_EXECUTION_GO / PRODUCT_IMPL_NO_GO / SCHEMA_V38_UNALLOCATED / #383_MERGE_HOLD / ACTIVE_DEVELOPMENT`.
